evidence.ES1301_methodology_summary: Populated: 'NSW/GDP extended to 2012 by Moos (2017), replicating Shaikh & Tonak methodology with post-1999 NIPA revision. 1959-2012 coverage. E2 excluded per [internal-decision-record]; standard formula NSW = E1 - T1 - T2*LS. 1959-1997 overlap mean = 0.013 in ST2 (Moos published = 0.011). Post-2001 structural break: unprecedented NSW rise to 8.6% of GDP in 2010.'
evidence.ES1302_methodology_summary: Populated: 'NSW/EC extended to 2012 by Moos (2017), using same formula as ES1301 but normalized by employee compensation rather than GDP.'
evidence.ES1304_methodology_summary: Populated: 'ES1301 restricted to 1959-1997, enabling direct comparison with ST 2002 coverage.'
evidence.ES1305_methodology_summary: Populated: 'ES1301 with post-2000 regime indicator. Quantifies the structural break in NSW/GDP identified by Moos (2017) as the main contribution of her paper.'
evidence.causal_decomposition_documented: ES1301 + ES1305 both document Moos's 4-factor causal decomposition (income support growth, healthcare inflation, neoliberal tax cuts, unemployment intensity)
evidence.decision_record_anchored: All four reference internal decision (2026-05-06): E2 excluded from NSW; ST2 overlap mean 0.013 vs Moos 0.011
evidence.robustness_check_documented: ES1305 documents Section 4.3 robustness with Mohun (2016) alternative labor share

L3_methodology_clarity.notes: Methodology is exceptionally well documented — formula, decomposition, robustness, and causal interpretation all in place for every series.
